title: Literature-audit robustness check, re-sliced on what was actually read
defect: the published check sliced on access_level, which records PUBLISHER accessibility, not whether the text was read
reading: no included study is coded as unread, so the read subset is 42 of 43 and its rates are within rounding of the headline. The access objection does not apply to the headline at all
